title: King David Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The King David Bible Crossword
description: Solve a King David Bible crossword: the shepherd boy, the harp, Jerusalem, Absalom and the psalms. KJV clues from 1 and 2 Samuel, free on iPhone and iPad.
prose: The youngest of eight sons, keeping sheep while his brothers are called in to meet the prophet — and the one God chooses, because the LORD looketh on the heart. King David covers the life rather than any single episode: the harp that quieted Saul, the years as a fugitive, the city he took and made his own, and the son who broke his heart.
If you want the giant, that is its own puzzle; if you want the psalm, so is Psalm 23. This grid is the man in between. It closes, fittingly, on the line he is best remembered for.

clues.text: He played it, and the evil spirit departed from Saul
Town where Samuel found him keeping sheep
His son who rebelled and was caught by his hair
Prophet who said “Thou art the man”

verseText: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
